title: Hydrodynamics of Filtered Dark Matter: A Two-Component Approach
summary: We study the hydrodynamics of the Filtered Dark Matter (Filtered DM) scenario during a first-order phase transition (FOPT). In this scenario, the bubble wall is highly reflective of the dark matter (DM) fluid but transparent to radiation, making the hydrodynamic problem fundamentally different from that of the electroweak FOPT.
